dashboard_drawer_noteInvalid.message: Note must be 200 characters or fewer

dashboard_drawer_reloadConfirmTitle.message: Reloading will discard your current changes. Continue?

dashboard_drawer_deleteConfirmDescriptio.message: You can re-add this contact later, but its note cannot be recovered.

dashboard_conflicts_staleError.message: This data changed while you were reviewing it. Reload to continue.

dashboard_settings_disabledNotice.message: The extension is currently off; these settings will apply once it's turned back on.

dashboard_import_exportCardDescription.message: The exported file is plain-text JSON and contains your private nicknames and notes - store it carefully.

dashboard_import_importCardDescription.message: Choose a compatible Your Name for Threads backup file. Depending on your directory's state, it will be restored or merged.

dashboard_import_invalidGeneric.message: This file is not a valid Your Name for Threads backup.

dashboard_import_invalidNewerVersion.message: This backup was created by a newer version of Your Name for Threads. Please update the extension and try again.

dashboard_import_blockingIssuesTitle.message: This backup contains conflicts that can't be resolved automatically

dashboard_import_confirmPendingConflicts.message: $1 more items will need confirmation after import

dashboard_import_noUndoNotice.message: This action has no one-click undo. Consider exporting your current data as a backup first.

dashboard_import_adoptIncomingIdCheckbox.message: Also adopt the imported account ID

dashboard_import_discardConfirmDescripti.message: Unfinished import progress will be lost. Your current Directory will not be modified.

dashboard_import_concurrencyDescription.message: Some related contacts were changed or deleted while you were reviewing. To avoid overwriting newer data, this backup needs to be reanalyzed.

dashboard_import_cancelledDescription.message: Your account status changed. Confirm you're signed in to the original account, then submit the import again.

dashboard_import_sessionExpired.message: The import session has ended. Please choose the backup file again.

dashboard_import_ownerMismatchTitle.message: This backup belongs to a different Threads account

dashboard_import_ownerMismatchDescriptio.message: Importing will add this backup's contacts as new entries in the current account's Directory. It will not restore the backup account's own Directory, and any contacts it had already deleted stay deleted here.

dashboard_accountUnresolved.message: Could not confirm the current Threads account

dashboard_accountUnresolvedDescription.message: Open Threads in a tab where you're logged in, then reopen the Directory from the extension popup.

dashboard_import_operationRestoreDescrip.message: Return the Directory to the state it was in when this backup was taken.

dashboard_import_operationMergeDescripti.message: Combine this backup's changes with the newer data already on this browser.

dashboard_import_operationExternalDescri.message: This backup comes from a different Directory, so its contacts are added to the current one as separate entries.

dashboard_import_noChangesNotice.message: This backup changes nothing in your Directory.

dashboard_import_restoreNoUndoNotice.message: Contacts added, edited or deleted since the backup may be lost, and this has no one-click undo. Consider exporting your current data first.

dashboard_import_restoreWarning.message: Restoring returns the Directory to the state it was in when the backup was taken. Contacts added, edited or deleted since then may be lost.

dashboard_import_restoreConfirmDescripti.message: Your current Directory will be replaced by this backup. There is no one-click undo.

dashboard_import_clearAccountDescription.message: Deletes $1's private nicknames, notes and deletion records in this browser. Other Threads accounts are unaffected.

dashboard_import_clearAccountConfirmDesc.message: This permanently deletes the current account's private nicknames, notes and deletion records in this browser. Other Threads accounts are unaffected. This cannot be undone.

dashboard_import_clearAccountSuccess.message: This account's Directory data was cleared.

dashboard_import_clearAccountError.message: Could not clear this account's data. Please try again.

onboarding_step1_body.message: Give people on Threads nicknames and notes that only you can see. Your data stays in your browser.

onboarding_step2_body.message: Sign in to Threads and open any profile to add a private nickname.

onboarding_step3_body.message: Your Name for Threads doesn't use cloud sync. Export a JSON backup from Backup & Import every so often.

dashboard_about_intro.message: A local-first, open-source private nickname and notes directory for Threads.

dashboard_about_privacyLocal.message: Nicknames and notes are stored in this browser and processed locally by the extension. They are not sent to the developer automatically.

dashboard_about_privacyNoTelemetry.message: This project runs no backend service that receives this data, and offers no cloud sync. There is no analytics, usage tracking, automatic crash reporting or advertising tracking.

dashboard_about_privacyBackup.message: A JSON backup is created only when you export one, for you to save. It contains private nicknames, notes and internal identifiers, so keep it safe and do not post it publicly.

dashboard_about_privacySharedProfile.message: Different Threads accounts use their own private directories in normal use.

dashboard_about_privacySharedProfileLimi.message: This separation is functional, not a cryptographic security boundary between people who share the same browser profile. If several people share a computer and need their private data kept apart, use separate browser profiles or operating system accounts.

dashboard_about_supportHelp.message: If something is not working, copy the diagnostics, then report the problem on GitHub.

dashboard_about_copyError.message: Could not copy diagnostics. Please try again.

dashboard_about_clearError.message: Could not clear diagnostics. Please try again.

dashboard_about_independent.message: This is an independent open-source project.

dashboard_about_vibeCoding.message: Built as an open-source vibe-coding project with assistance from OpenAI models and Claude Code.

dashboard_about_backupReminder.message: Export a backup regularly, so you do not lose your data if the browser's data is cleared.

dashboard_about_supportDiagnostics.message: Diagnostics are kept on this device, up to the 20 most recent events, and are never uploaded automatically. The copied diagnostics include the version, runtime state, counts and error codes.

dashboard_about_supportPrivate.message: Please do not paste private nicknames, notes, a full JSON backup or recovery data into a public issue. For a security vulnerability or a privacy leak, use the private channel described in the security policy.

dashboard_about_nameNote.message: We came up with plenty of names (Book of Threads, Threads Yūjin-chō, Your Threads' name, Friends on Threads..). This is the one that stuck.

recovery_descriptionDirectory.message: Your Name for Threads cannot safely read this account's private directory. To avoid changing it any further, the private directory features are paused for this account. Other accounts are not affected.

recovery_descriptionGlobal.message: Your Name for Threads cannot safely read its stored data. To avoid changing it any further, the private directory features are paused for every account in this browser.

recovery_exportWarningDirectory.message: Recovery data may contain private nicknames, notes and internal identifiers. Do not post it publicly, for example in a GitHub issue.

recovery_exportWarningGlobal.message: Recovery data may contain private nicknames, notes and internal identifiers, and because all of the stored data is affected it includes every account's data. Do not post it publicly, for example in a GitHub issue.

recovery_exportError.message: Could not export recovery data. Please try again.

recovery_noRepair.message: There is no automatic repair, and the extension cannot import a recovery file. The file is for you, or a developer, to read.

recovery_clearDescription.message: Clearing deletes this account's damaged data for good. Other accounts and the settings are not affected. Export recovery data first if you want to keep a copy.

recovery_clearConfirmDescription.message: This deletes this account's damaged private directory. It cannot be undone. Export recovery data first if you want to keep a copy.

recovery_globalNoClear.message: Clearing is not offered because the data of every account is affected. Export recovery data and report the problem instead.
